ranks: Marvel Super Heroes Commander (MSC, 2026-06-26): top 50% by EDHREC rank, its next 59, with mayhem built (rule 702.187) and the four mayhem cards it unblocked (Chameleon, Oscorp Industries, The Squadron Sinister, Abomination)

blocked.name: Kang Prime
blocked.why: "Put two time counters on that card. If it doesn't have suspend, it gains suspend" - no effect grants suspend to an exiled card

blocked.name: Avenge
blocked.why: cost reduction "if a player attacked you during their last turn": state tracks it (attackedYouDuringTheirLastTurn) but no StaticCondition reads it

blocked.name: Silver Surfer, Galactus's Herald
blocked.why: "until the end of your next turn, target creature attacks that player each combat if able" - no attack requirement naming a player, no end-of-your-next-turn duration

blocked.name: Okoye, Mighty and Adored
blocked.why: "Whenever that creature attacks the monarch this turn" - no delayed trigger on a captured creature attacking, and no attacks-the-monarch defender clause

blocked.name: Stilt-Man, Towering Terror
blocked.why: gain-control and cant-be-sacrificed last until end of turn or indefinitely; "until the end of your next turn" isn't a duration either has

blocked.name: Heroic Return
blocked.why: cost reduction "if a creature is attacking you": no condition or filter clause names the defending player (an attacker aimed at another opponent mustn't count)

blocked.name: Storm, Queen of Wakanda
blocked.why: 'Storm deals damage equal to her power to that creature' (the attacker): damage takes only a target slot; a one-sided fight with the trigger object deals nothing once Storm has left, where the ability should still deal damage by her last-known power (rule 608.2h)

blocked.name: Fantastic Elasticity
blocked.why: Rebound isn't built

blocked.name: It's Clobberin' Time!
blocked.why: Rebound isn't built

blocked.name: Kimoyo Beads
blocked.why: 'Choose one that hasn't been chosen' (ever, for this object — Prime Bead's self-flicker resets it): modal's notChosenThisTurn forgets at end of turn

blocked.name: Crimson Cowl, Master of Evil
blocked.why: 'Whenever one or more nontoken Villains you control attack a player' fires once per player attacked: attacks-player has no attacker filter, attack-with fires once per declaration

blocked.name: Vision, Spectral Synthezoid
blocked.why: 'Once during each of your turns, you may cast a noncreature or Robot spell from your hand without paying its mana cost': no static once-per-turn free cast from hand (player-effect castFromHandFree is a one-shot for a turn, unlimited)

blocked.name: Captain America, Skybound
blocked.why: Battalion ('~ and at least two other creatures attack') has no trigger; attack-with can't require the source among the attackers

blocked.name: The Spear of Bashenga
blocked.why: 'Whenever equipped creature attacks the monarch' has no defender-is-monarch trigger clause, and 'target tapped nonland permanent that player controls' needs the equipped attacker's defending player as a target's controller

blocked.name: Hercules, Olympian Hero
blocked.why: 'Whenever Hercules is dealt damage for the first time each turn': dealt-damage has no firstTimeEachTurn, and oncePerTurn differs once the ability is lost and regained mid-turn.

blocked.name: Heart-Shaped Herb
blocked.why: 'If a source an opponent controls would deal damage to you, prevent 1 of that damage': would-deal-damage prevents all or nothing (no prevent-N); the sacrifice-and-return ability wasn't examined further.

blocked.name: Vision, Synthezoid Avenger
blocked.why: The second mode is 'Vision phases out'; phasing isn't modeled.

blocked.name: Stark's Ingenuity
blocked.why: 'Whenever you draw a card, put a +1/+1 counter on enchanted creature': no EffectTargetRef names the Aura's host (a granted trigger would make the creature's controller the 'you').

blocked.name: Human Torch
blocked.why: 'Until end of turn, whenever he deals combat damage to an opponent, he deals that much damage to each other opponent': DelayedCombatDamage fires with neither the amount nor the player dealt damage (no triggerValue / trigger-player).

blocked.name: Wolverine, Claws Out
blocked.why: 'You may have Wolverine assign his combat damage as though he weren't blocked' has no static.

blocked.name: First Family
blocked.why: X is the colours among permanents you control AND spells you've cast this turn, together; colorsAmong reads only battlefield permanents.

blocked.name: Lady Loki, Agent of Chaos
blocked.why: 'Exile it' — the cast spell, from the stack, as a cast trigger resolves — then reveal-until and the mana-value difference; no effect exiles the triggering spell.
